name: Main
comment: Intel 8086 main instruction set — 1-15 byte variable-length encoding.
First byte is the opcode (or prefix). ModR/M / SIB / displacement / immediate
follow per the well-known x86 grammar; those are consumed by emitters via
win over broader patterns. Single-opcode entries (mask=0xFF) come first;
follow. Group group/ files are loaded in the order listed below.
24.6.1 — scaffolding only. Group files added incrementally in later
sub-phases (24.6.2 NOP/HLT smoke, 24.6.5 MOV, 24.6.6 ALU, 24.6.7 rest).
